notes.title: Update 1.2.2 goes live on October 21, 2026, at 8:00 AM UTC. Downtime runs from 6:00 AM to 8:00 AM UTC.

items.text: Update 1.2.2 brings the Halloween event, buffs for Hound and both of his vehicles, balance changes for Ember's M1150 ABV and fire effects, Store improvements, and a round of bug fixes. Here's everything that's changed.

Something wicked is rolling onto the battlefield. The Halloween event brings a spooky makeover of the Inferno One map and a limited-time Halloween Event Pass packed with themed rewards. Stay tuned for more info including exact event times and unlockable goodies.
20v20: Score needed to win: 2,000 → 2,500. The extra base meant 20v20 matches ended about 20% faster than standard Conquest; this brings them back in line.
Chance for Kill Confirmed matches has been reduced.
Fire status applied by napalm: 650 → 108 per 0.25 s, as part of the fire and napalm changes under the M1150 ABV below.
The ramming mass bonus is now only active while sprinting.
Reduced pushing strength: ramming mass bonus 215 → 180
These changes respond to Season 2 player feedback on the M1150 ABV. Much of the Fire pressure players felt came from fire world effects, so those and napalm have been toned down as well.
Heat retuned for shorter bursts with faster recovery (about 5 s of continuous fire before overheating).
Turret side armor on the bustle: 260 mm → 230 mm
Collision shape now matches the XM1V's.
Fire and Napalm World Effects (all vehicles)
Made alongside the M1150 ABV changes, based on the same player feedback.
Fire status applied by fire world effects: 650 → 72 per 0.25 s
Fire status applied by napalm, including Reaper's Napalm In The Morning Ultimate: 650 → 108 per 0.25 s

Hound and both of his vehicles get a round of buffs and quality-of-life fixes. The LEO 1A6A1 is the starter tank and the first step into the Marksman role, so we want it to feel more comfortable and more rewarding to play.

Hunting Time could destroy enemies in two ways: by executing them at 30% HP or less, or with the missile's raw damage. Only executes granted a recast, so players often expected a recast that never came. These changes make every Hunting Time kill work the same way.
Hunting Time now executes any enemy at or below 1,200 HP, in addition to enemies at 30% HP or less, and every execute grants a recast.
Fixed an issue where Hunting Time couldn't execute Raketa during Rampage or Reaper during Relentless. Any enemy at or below 1,200 HP is now destroyed.
Destroying decoys, such as the LEO 1A6A1's Decoy and the LEO 2FK's proxy, no longer grants a recast.
Rapid Flow: Cooldown of all abilities -25% → -20%
Slow and Steady: Now active only when moving under 5 km/h (was under 33 km/h). Bonus unchanged: +10% turret traverse speed and aiming speed.
MBP18: Now grants Reactive Agility (+10% Engine Power, +15% Hull Traverse) when your ammo rack is hit, with a 20 s cooldown. Previously granted 25 Boost Energy when your fuel tank was hit.

MTU MB838: Overdrive on kill or assist now lasts the full 10 s (was 3 s), matching similar modules on other vehicles. Engine Power drawback removed. New drawbacks: Aiming Speed -4.47%, Reticle Size While Moving +10.24%.
Bundles: Bundles now stay available in the Store even if you already own some of their items. The purchase screen shows which items you already own and the compensation you get for duplicates.
Equip button: The Equip button is now unlocked for any item you can still buy.

Where to get items: The Appearance screen now shows every place you can get an item (Store, Battle Pass, and more) instead of only two. Up to three show by default, with an option to expand the full list.
Tutorials: The Loadout and Modules tutorials, shown when you first open these sections, have been updated to match the new "How It Works" screens.
Fixed an issue where the MARDER 1A3's Smart Mines could apply their negative effects to one enemy and their damage to a different nearby enemy.

Fixed an issue where the M3E1's MEW-718A module only reset main gun heat on main gun kills. Kills with any weapon, including rams and secondary weapons, now reset heat and also immediately end the overheat lockout, so you can fire again right away.
Fixed an issue on Kent's XM1 90 where, with the CLM-43 and PDU-1546S modules installed, Combat Reboot could fire an extra full magazine for free.
Fixed an issue on Reaper's M60A2 with the XM248 module where switching to Airburst and back let the main gun skip its reload. Switching back from Airburst now requires a full main gun reload.
Fixed an issue where destroying an enemy with the M551A1's Canister Volley didn't grant Overdrive with the GH-19 module installed.
Fixed an issue where Eagle Eye from the LEO 2KST's MUKS 1 module increased the reticle size instead of reducing it while Active Camo was active.
Fixed an issue where LEO 2KST modules that change the EMP Trap cooldown didn't work correctly.
Fixed an issue where grease from the ALVT's Dirty Substance ability didn't affect bots.
Plant & Defuse: Fixed an issue where the bomb couldn't be defused after the defusing player was pushed out of the defuse circle.
Plant & Defuse: Fixed an issue where the bomb disappeared when a bot carrying it was destroyed.
Jammed equipment now has a clearer indicator on the ability bar.
Fixed an issue where the Role Points event log could show the wrong name for a destroyed enemy.
Fixed an issue where the Ground Damage vignette didn't appear after taking damage from the LEO 2KST's EMP Trap.
Fixed an issue where the "Losing" marker showed instead of "Neutralizing" when retaking a base the enemy had only partly captured.
Fixed an issue where opening the Game Modes list after a battle switched your mode to Quick Match.
Fixed inconsistent spelling of the Vulcan Auto Turret in the M1E1's module descriptions.
Fixed oversized sparks that appeared after recent FSR fixes.
Fixed visual artifacts on autocannon hits on sand.
Improved performance of the M1150 ABV's flamethrower effect when viewed through the sniper scope.
Fixed an issue where sounds became muffled after using Hound's Hunting Time in the final seconds of a round in Control mode.
The ESC "go back" action now plays its own sound instead of a regular click.
Fixed an issue where agent voice lines could be heard in the Garage even with agent audio turned off.
Fixed an issue on Xbox and PS5 where a platform friend's in-game name didn't appear in the friends list until you logged in again, if they joined the game during your session.
Fixed an issue on Xbox, PS5, and Discord external invites where accepting an invite during a battle while in a Squad left you in your old Squad after the battle.
Fixed an issue on Xbox (Microsoft Store) where purchased items didn't appear in your inventory until the game was restarted.
Fixed broken text scrolling in the Store on PS5.
Fixed a crash related to audio decoding.
Reduced GPU memory usage on AMD graphics cards.
Update 1.2.1 goes live on September 24, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC. Downtime runs from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM UTC.

Update 1.2.1 adds 20 new Legendary modules, a set of new features and quality-of-life improvements, a broad balance pass across abilities, modules, and vehicles, and a long list of bug fixes. Here's everything that's changed.

Friends, Requests, and Blocked now sit in the Garage, grouped by where each player comes from: in-game, platform (Xbox, PSN, Steam), or Discord. You can look someone up and send a request, and incoming requests arrive as notifications.
You can invite to Squad as always, with the ability to remove a friend. Check it out in the game!
Update 1.2.1 adds one new Legendary module for every vehicle: twenty in total. Each one reshapes a signature ability or role, trading a powerful new effect against tuned stat changes.
Replaces HESH-T rounds in the secondary magazine with AP rounds.
Incoming Crit Modifier for Ammo Rack: +5%
+5% to damage for each enemy you destroy, up to a maximum of 25%. Stacks reset upon vehicle destruction or round end.

Using Charge grants Hellfire. While engulfed in Hellfire, it gains 100% resistance to Fire, Interference, and Slow, and creates a moving Fire area that applies the Burning status effect to nearby enemies.
Hitting an enemy with an HE shell restores 4 Ultimate Energy.
Switches to HEAT rockets. If Rocket Barrage destroys an enemy, its cooldown is reset for the next 6 s and it can be reused at no cost.
+1 Boost Energy for every 20 damage you deal.
Replaces the default burst magazine with an autoloader and changes its shell from AP to APHE.
M551A1 · BCA-803 (Active Protection System Ability Module)
+20% to damage, +30% to penetration power, and -10% to reload time for 15 s after blocking a shell.
+10% temporary HP and +15% to frontal turret armor upon receiving a status effect. Cooldown: 30 s
M1150 ABV · ATLIC (Line Charges Ability Module)
If Line Charges destroys an enemy, its cooldown is reset and it can be reused at no cost for the next 6 s.
M1E1 · LCP-179 (Active Protection System Ability Module)

The APS can be discharged at enemies while active. Damage dealt scales with the shield HP remaining after absorbing incoming damage: the less HP remaining, the more damage dealt (minimum 300). Your vehicle is Slowed while the discharge is active. Damage is dealt in a short cone in front of the vehicle.
Drains ability Energy from enemies inside the Jamming Field. If an enemy under this effect reaches 0 ability Energy, they take 500 damage. Cooldown: 45 s
Blocking 750 damage grants Lucky Strike, Empowered, and Tactical Resistance for the next 15 s.
Tactical Resistance: Removes status effects from the vehicle and makes it temporarily immune to all status effects.
Instantly repairs broken tracks. Cooldown: 15 s
+20% to damage dealt to Traced enemies.
+3% to ammo, engine, and fuel critical damage for every target you Trace, up to a maximum of 15%. Resets upon destruction or round end.
Damaging an enemy with the main gun makes all enemies within 80 m of the target Traced. Cooldown: 20 s
Active Camo is no longer canceled when EMP Trap is used or the main gun is fired.
Destroying an enemy resets main gun heat.
After remaining stationary for 2 s, your next 2 shots or bursts (main gun or ability) produce no data. Moving after being stationary for 5 s reduces movement data by 75% for 5 s.

Update 1.2.1 brings a broad balance pass. General changes come first, then everything grouped by vehicle. A recurring theme this update: many placeable abilities can now be temporarily disabled by an enemy Jamming Field.
Standardized loader and shell type descriptions across all vehicles for consistency.
Phantom Curtain smoke now launches from a dedicated slot on all vehicles instead of from the gun.
Fragile: Duration increased from 3 s to 15 s; penetration bonus per stack reduced slightly (1.09x to 1.075x); stacking no longer extends duration.
Wings of War: Velocity bonus reduced from 1.5x to 1.2x.
Fixed an issue where some destroyed placeable abilities (e.g. the LEO 2KST's EMP Trap) could disappear without a destruction effect.

Placeable abilities disabled by a Jamming Field now show a spark effect and stop functioning appropriately (mines won't trigger, probes stop detecting, Decoy stops acting, Bastion stops healing, EMP Trap and Tesla Discs stops pulsing, Smart Mines stop targeting).

Status resistance affects status accumulation and status decay. By increasing status decay only, we keep the original intent of the progression modules (stay under a given status effect for less time) without allowing for permanent status immunity and complete damage mitigation.
M1150 Breacher (ISAC): Fire Resistance +50% changed to Fire Status Decay +50%.
FV4030 (ADFT-176): Interference Resistance +54.5% changed to Interference Status Decay +54.5%.
LEO 2FK (MB839 KA500): Fixed the Holy Fire modifier to work as intended (+75% all status decay).

Raketa's Ultimate has been a big point of discussion and feedback. We aim to reduce its impact, especially in Kill Confirmed, by reducing the stims provided during the Ultimate and letting default countermeasures (high-APM damage sources) work regardless of Raketa's HP when the Ultimate is used. This should also introduce some decision-making for Raketa himself, through considering when to activate the Ultimate.
Rampage's duration can now be reduced with damage regardless of Raketa's vehicle's HP.
Shell Magazine Loading Time in Rampage: 0.3 → 0.4
Fixed the Rampage Overstay tooltip to correctly display 3 seconds instead of 5.
Unseen Fighter: Fixed an issue where the effect could end earlier than intended.

The XM1 90 underperforms at low investment levels, so we're dropping FASTDRAW Magazines' Energy cost for an easier time learning how to ammo juggle (in this Energy economy), and increasing base mobility, particularly uphill and at low gear, for easier movement over uneven terrain or when the tank is brought to a standstill.
Uphill engine force increased on initial startup.
Engine power multipliers for gears 1, 2, and 3 increased.

The APHE module should now be even compared to the previously changed old Zealous. Setting a tank on fire will now require an extra hit on top of a fuel crit. We're also making the distinction between the two mods clearer: MS-253 is for the designated fast-shooting playstyle, while the other is for less frequent but harder shots. This concludes our campaign against the ALVT for the time being.
MS-253: Reload time from -12% to -16.2%; Fire status on hit reduced from 400 to 95.
Suppressive Fire had an excessive cooldown for its role in the tank's play pattern. We're dropping it so it can become more relevant in the M60A1's ram-heavy playstyle.
Cooldown reduced from 40 s to 30 s.

The T-62AV has been brawling a bit too well, blurring its intended role of a guerrilla opportunist. We're reducing the cost of Pyro-Trail for more fiery disruption, while winding down the frequency of Rocket Barrage and dropping HP, so it has to choose its engagements a little more wisely.

The OBJ. 287's HP exceeded Assault-class values due to the very all-in nature of the tank, but that turned out to be a little overbearing, so we're reining it in. Combat Cage has been compressed to make the pattern of locking an enemy inside it more frequent and dynamic, and we've reevaluated shell parameters to make them more accurate to our models.
Cooldown reduced from 45 s to 30 s, duration reduced from 30 s to 20 s.
Mines from the PTM-37A module can now be temporarily disabled by an enemy Jamming Field.
Burst Full Reload Time: 8.0 s → 10.0 s

Recon Probes have been a little crazy in terms of combat data generated. To diminish the constant wallhack, we're reducing the duration and detection radius while increasing placement radius. We want the HSTV-L to have more frequent interaction with the probes in moment-to-moment gameplay. Similarly to the OBJ. 287, the HSTV-L's AP shell parameters have also been reevaluated.
MK19 Auto Turret: Cooldown reduced from 40 s to 35 s.
Recon Probes: Duration reduced from 120 s to 80 s, radius reduced from 100 m to 60 m, and placement range increased from 40 m to 55 m.
Recon Probes' effects can now be temporarily disabled by an enemy's Jamming Field.
Fixed an issue where Recon Probes' effect could still apply after the enemy vehicle left the detection zone.
Fixed an issue where the size of an ally's Masked zone didn't match the detection zone.
Burst Full Reload Time: 8.8 s → 9.2 s
The M551A1 is getting some highly requested improvements to mobility to make traversing the battlefield and flanking enemies more comfortable and responsive.
Overall vehicle mobility improved (hull traverse, center of mass).
It's now easier to spot placed mines. Don't drive into them.
Mine warning light draw distance increased from 25 m to 50 m.
Mines can now be temporarily disabled by enemy Jamming Fields.

Bastion now heals baseline. Skill and internal cooldowns have been reduced slightly for better cycles, but at the cost of lower HP. Overall, we want it to have a greater team impact instead of serving only as extra cover for the FV4030 X itself. Mod tweaks should offer better building decision-making.

We also changed Jamming Field so it's easier to maintain and toggle off without suffering so much on the economy side. On the other hand, Interference now builds up gradually based on distance to the FV4030 X, so caster tanks have an easier time fighting it without being dead-zoned completely.

Bastion: Now restores 40 HP/s by default in an area directly behind the shield (shown with a green rectangle); this healing can be temporarily disabled by an enemy's Jamming Field. Internal cooldown reduced from 5 s to 3 s, charge cooldown reduced from 40 s to 35 s, shield HP reduced from 2000 to 1500, shield HP decay reduced from 10/s to 7.5/s, placement distance adjusted (min 5 m, max 8 m), and aiming-camera vertical rotation limits updated.

Jamming Field: Cost reduced from 10 to 6; status strength at 36 m reduced from 40% to 33%, status strength at 24 m changed from 60% to 66%, hold-to-cancel time reduced from 1 s to 0.3 s. Now also temporarily disables enemy placeables (mines, probes, etc.) within its radius. Ability description updated.
BASTION MK1/3 now applies Traced to enemies shooting allies within the effect area, in addition to applying it when Bastion shields are shot.
BASTION MK2/L now applies a single stack of Warded but reduces HP restoration by 25% and total Bastion charges by 1.
INENBAT-5 now reduces Jamming Field's Energy cost by 10%, up from 5%.
Shell parameters have been reevaluated to reflect our models accurately.
Can now be temporarily disabled by an enemy Jamming Field.
Reduced Decoy cost will provide extra cycles over time and allow the LEO 1A6A1 to use decoys more liberally. More mindgames!
Can now be temporarily disabled by an enemy Jamming Field.
Top-Attack Missiles economy has been greatly improved to better reflect its intended damage profile. We're also slightly reducing UAV Drone cooldown to support the Top-Attack changes.
We're dropping duration of Electro-Optical Jammers to create slightly longer vulnerability windows for frontal exchanges.
Electro Optical Jammers: Duration reduced from 15 s to 10 s.
Feign Death: Now ends upon a fired shell's impact, instead of when the gun fires.
The ORI module now grants Overdrive and Masked for 10 s after exiting Feign Death.
The BOINAYEL BHZ-2786 and OYA RK-5673 modules now also affect reload time with VGS-152G.
New effect added · Missile Max Speed: x1.75
Critical modifiers changed from +30% to +10% each, now: ammo crit +0.23, engine crit +0.15, fuel crit +0.138
The munitions used by the LEO 2KST and other vehicles featuring magazine loaders have had their damage and penetration values updated to boost the performance of guns with longer cycle times.
Can now be temporarily disabled by an enemy Jamming Field.
BDK-3: Autoloader changed to a passive loader (shells load in automatically); loading time 5 s to 5.25 s; shell-count loading time 3 s to 2.63 s
VSB-1246: Hull traverse from 20% to 8.3%; engine force from -6% to -20%
Multiple hull, turret, and gun armor values rebalanced.
Before: Swapped in a burst-fire gun and ammo loader, showing burst-related stats and a "changes loader to burst" description.
After: None of that; the module now condenses the damage of each burst into a single shell.
Before: No Slow effect value set.
After: Slow status value of 480 added, capped at 1 trigger event.

We're introducing some quality-of-life changes and a power shift to the MARDER 1A3. Mine economy and placement have been improved, and rotating skills are more fluent than before. The primary shell has been changed to AP for more consistent damage, but it requires more conscious use of Vulnerable stacks and a bit more space due to lower turret traverse.

Smart Mines: Max deployment range increased from 25 m to 30 m, Energy cost reduced from 25 to 20. No longer blocks using Suppression Strike or Strike Laser while active. Can now be temporarily disabled by an enemy Jamming Field.

Suppression Strike: Reload time reduced from 15 s to 13 s, shell-swap time reduced from 2.2 s to 2 s. Now always applies 3 stacks of Fragile on hit to all damaged targets, including indirect hits (still capped at 5 stacks). No longer blocks using Smart Mines or Strike Laser while active. General improvements to canceling and switching the ability mid-use.
BKF-305: Effect changed to 13 Slow status applied by the primary weapon.
EVS-328: The debuff now reduces AP penetration (to account for the shell change), from the previous APHE penetration stat.
Multiple hull, turret, and gun armor values rebalanced.

Discord Invites (PC): Players with a linked Discord account can now invite their Discord friends to a squad or to the game directly from the game client, and Discord Rich Presence now has a working "Join" button so friends can jump straight into your session from Discord. Available on WGC and Steam (PC only).
New Agent and vehicle icons: New, higher-resolution Agent portraits and vehicle icons on the Agent Selection screen, optimized for 4K displays.
Battle Pass season header: The season banner section in the Battle Pass now displays a "Season X" header.

Vehicle preview zoom controls: Zoom controls for vehicle previews in the Garage (Customization, Armor and Modules, and Store skin previews) are now fixed and no longer follow your battle key bindings: Scroll Up/Down on KBM, and Right Stick Click on controller.

Reworked "Bundle Includes": The "Bundle Includes" section on bundle product pages now shows a full, itemized list of everything in the bundle (type, name, amount, and associated vehicle/Agent where applicable) instead of just aggregated totals.

Reworked Missions screen: Missions are now grouped into sections sorted by priority, empty or fully completed sections are hidden automatically, and the "Go to Mission" banner has been replaced with a header.
Fixed an issue where the OBJ. 287's Combat Cage ability could collide with smoke, sometimes launching tanks into the air.

Fixed an issue where player input could stop registering (unable to open the menu or control the vehicle after the intro cinematic) when starting the Operation Phoenix tutorial mission or a battle on Project Phoenix, especially if pressing buttons rapidly while the map was loading.
Fixed an issue where the Line Charges ability for Ember's M1150 ABV didn't deal damage to soft cover.
Fixed an issue where the Traced status from the T-72SH's OTSHU-1-19 module would expire partway through Disruption Field Generator's duration instead of lasting the whole time.
Fixed an issue on the LEO 2FK where HP restoration with a Recovery Kit or Rebuild Kit would stop after returning from Feign Death, even without taking further damage.
Fixed an issue where vehicle turrets could randomly stop following the camera during battle, continuing to rotate but aiming in the wrong direction.
Fixed an issue where M551A1 bots wouldn't use the Canister Volley ability.
Fixed an issue on the Aircraft Carrier map where vehicles could drive through the garage gates due to a missing collision.
Fixed an issue where part of the ability UI would remain visible on the tactical map after using the M1150 ABV's Line Charges, the M60A3E2's Blast Projectors, or the LEO 2KST's Active Camo.
Fixed an issue where the Operation Phoenix tutorial mission notification "Investigate the facility and capture Base B" would incorrectly appear in Firing Range mode.
Fixed an issue where the wrong mission condition was displayed in battle instead of "Win 3 battles."
Fixed an issue where already activated Skill notifications would reappear one after another after respawning.
Fixed an issue where the crosshair wasn't displayed in the reticle when using Static aim mode on either of Fuzzer's vehicles.
Fixed an issue in Plant/Defuse where the "Carrying the bomb, assist me" ping wasn't displayed in the battle log.
Fixed an issue where the crosshair would disappear on the XM1 90 when activating the FASTDRAW Magazines ability with the XM364 module equipped.
Fixed an issue on Hound's LEO 1A6A1 where a conditional widget could appear without a title or icon.
Fixed an issue where the FV 4030 X's Jamming Field ability showed the guided rocket targeting icon (green triangle) on affected enemies instead of the correct white square icon.
Fixed an issue where the FV4030 X's Jamming Field ability displayed the distance to the affected enemy when it shouldn't have.
Fixed an issue where the background of some long subtitles during the Operation Phoenix tutorial mission didn't stretch to fit the full length of the text.
Fixed an outdated Burning Magazine effect description for the MSF 53 module for Flair's LEO 2KST.
Fixed an issue where post-battle screen buttons were missing if the game client wasn't the focused window.
Fixed an issue where the camera wouldn't zoom in on an equipped charm when opening the Customization tab in the Armor menu.
Fixed an issue where the vehicle preview wouldn't update after selecting or equipping a new skin in the Customization tab. (The same issue also affected charm previews.)
Fixed an issue where Steam and Steam Deck platform icons weren't displayed in the Squad menu.

Fixed an issue where, after finishing a 20v20 battle in a Squad, the non-leader's game mode selection would reset to Quick Match, and the Squad leader would need to press Play twice to queue for 20v20 again.
Fixed an issue on Steam and consoles where the Friends and Blocked lists would show a loading spinner indefinitely and never display until the client was relaunched.

Fixed the RT 523T module description on Twister's HSTV-L: Traced and Masked are now bolded, the cooldown now shows its time unit (e.g. "Cooldown: 20 s"), and the incorrect Masked duration display has been removed.
Fixed an issue where the Solid Gold skin would produce overly intense sun glare on maximum graphics settings.
Fixed an issue where the skill matrix on the Agent Skills screen was hard to read against the new Garage background, especially on low-contrast monitors.
Fixed an issue where the M1150 ABV's armor plates would flicker while recovering after being destroyed.
Fixed an issue where some parts of M60A1 would turn white when destroyed while using the Tempered 3D skin.
Fixed an issue where the Tactical View (M) had significant flickering during Conquest battles on the Aircraft Carrier map.
Fixed an issue where Kill Confirmed Tokens were missing their visual effects, appearing as plain metal plates instead.
Fixed an issue where the M1150 ABV's Incendiary Launchers ability didn't leave scorch tracks on sand terrain.
Fixed an issue where the FV4030 X's Jamming Field ability decal would disappear if the ability stayed active for more than 60 seconds.
Fixed an issue where the aim trajectory for Ember's XM1V's Minefield and Demolition Charges abilities would remain visible after the player was destroyed.
Fixed an issue where most in-battle sounds would be missing for a Squad member if they were watching the season trailer when the battle started.
Fixed a voice chat issue where players with restricted communication weren't shown a mute icon and couldn't be muted correctly by other Squad members.
Fixed an issue in Control mode where HQ would play a losing voice line for the team that captured the base instead of a winning one.
Fixed incorrect shell type descriptions in the Store's firing mode info for the XM1 90, ALVT, M60A2, OBJ. 287, M551A1, XM1V, FV4030 X, LEO 1A6A1, M3E1, and MARDER 1A3.
Fixed an issue in the Operation Phoenix tutorial mission where the crosshair wouldn't track a moving enemy with a gamepad's Aim Assist setting enabled.

Fixed an issue on Xbox where suspending and resuming the game could leave the in-game Store in an inconsistent state, causing a previously failed currency purchase to complete unexpectedly on the next purchase attempt.
Fixed an issue on Xbox and PS5 where mouse scroll wheel input would not work in battle or on the Armor screen, even when rebound to a different input.
Fixed an issue where selecting a module with a gamepad in the Modules tab (Modify Vehicle > Armor) didn't work.
Fixed an issue where, with the Menu panel open, the Control Hints for Settings couldn't be accessed on Xbox, PS5, or PC. The same issue also prevented opening the Store from the currency tooltip.
Fixed an issue on the Armor screen where clicking Input Hints played a sound but didn't perform any action.
Fixed an issue where description text for the Armor and Modules tabs wasn't displayed when using a gamepad or on console.
Fixed an issue where the Audio Preset dropdown options in Settings > Audio were missing translations in non-English languages.
Heads up: Update 1.1.3 is scheduled to go live on Friday, August 21, with planned maintenance from 07:00 to 09:00 UTC (about two hours).

Plant/Defuse is back for Bomb Squad Weekend, running Friday, August 21 through Sunday, August 23. The mode is still in an open testing phase, and this weekend's opening hours, its battle-earnings test, and its leaderboard change all trace back to your feedback from last weekend. This article also covers a short list of Plant/Defuse fixes shipping in Update 1.1.3, further down the page.

Plant/Defuse first launched last weekend with a single opening window each day, timed for Europe and landing in the middle of the day for North America. This weekend adds two more windows, both landing during North American evenings, so more of you will have a convenient time to play!
New to Plant/Defuse? The mode guide covers how planting, defusing, and round wins work.
Bomb Squad Weekend runs across five opening windows over the weekend, for 29 hours of playable time in total.
1Fri 21 Aug 15:00 to Sat 22 Aug 00:00Fri 17:00 to Sat 02:00Fri 11:00 to Fri 20:00Fri 08:00 to Fri 17:00

notes.title: Five battles, one charm, three boosters

items.text: Play five Plant/Defuse battles at any point during Bomb Squad Weekend and you'll earn the Bomb Squad Charm, plus three boosters, one of each type. Battles count across any of the five opening windows, so however your schedule shakes out, five battles gets you there.
Update 1.1.3 lands alongside Bomb Squad Weekend and improves Plant/Defuse in a few concrete ways.

Credits, Agent XP, and Vehicle XP from Plant/Defuse battles have been increased by 80% following your results and feedback. We want to make sure that Plant/Defuse payouts line up more closely with our other game modes.

Ranking on the in-game Top 100 Plant/Defuse leaderboard now takes 15 battles, up from five. That's a harder bar to clear, and it's meant to be: with more battles required, the board reflects players who've actually put in the work, not just an early lead. Note: The leaderboard screen itself will keep showing the old number until a later client update catches up.
Faster matches: Queue times will feel shorter. Matchmaking now widens its search in smaller, quicker steps, so you'll get into games faster while still keeping early matches well balanced.
Better skill matching: We've given the matchmaker more precision when judging player skill, so it can better tell the difference between a fair match and a lopsided one.
Roles: Team composition (roles) now matters slightly less than skill balance when building matches.

Squads: Matches will be fairer for squads. We've increased the penalty for uneven squads between teams, so you're less likely to face a team full of coordinated squads while your team is mostly solo players.
Map pool: The Plant/Defuse map pool has been reduced from six maps to four. Project Phoenix and Moonshot have been removed. Remaining maps: Blossom Crash, Scarred City, Sunstroke, and Eden.
Fixed a server crash that could happen when a defuse attempt coincided with the bomb timer expiring.
Fixed a bug where squad matchmaking used Quick Match stats instead of Plant/Defuse stats. Squads queuing for Plant/Defuse are now matched on their actual Plant/Defuse performance.
Fixed a rare issue where a recent battle could be missing from a player's stats.
Plant/Defuse is in an open testing phase, so its rules, timing, and rewards are still being worked out. There's more to come after this weekend.
If you have thoughts on what's working and what isn't, the HEAT Discord is the best place to share your feedback directly with the team.
Q: Why can't I find Plant/Defuse outside the listed hours?
A: Plant/Defuse is still in open testing, so it only runs during the scheduled windows above. Check back for future testing weekends.
Q: Does the leaderboard change affect my five-battle reward?
A: No. The five-battle participation reward, the Bomb Squad Charm plus three boosters, is unchanged. The 15-battle requirement only applies to ranking on the in-game Top 100 leaderboard.
Q: Why does the in-game leaderboard still say 5 battles?
A: The in-game screen hasn't caught up yet and will update in a later client release. Until then, 15 is the number that counts for Top 100 ranking this weekend.
Q: Do I need to update or download anything for Update 1.1.3?
A: Update 1.1.3 doesn't require a client download or install; it's applied on the server side.
Play five Plant/Defuse battles between Friday, August 21 and Sunday, August 23 to earn the Bomb Squad Charm and three boosters.
Update 1.1.2 goes live on August 12, 2026, at 7:00 AM UTC. Downtime runs from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM UTC.

Update 1.1.2 introduces a new game mode, Top 100 leaderboards, and in-battle vehicle rotation, plus Role Point tuning, Operation Phoenix mission improvements, and a wave of fixes. Here's everything that's changed.
Please note: Plant/Defuse is an experimental game mode. Rewards and mechanics are not final, so please share your feedback.
Get ready for something new on the battlefield: Plant/Defuse is here! Plant the charge and hold your ground, or push in and defuse it before time runs out.

Plant/Defuse lives in its own dedicated mode, separate from Quick Match, so every battle you join is packed with other players who picked the same fight. Catch it during special event windows, and keep your eyes peeled for more details coming soon.
Jump in every weekend this August
Plant/Defuse is playable only during these windows. Times are shown in your local time where available, with UTC as the reference.
Plant the charge and hold, or push in and defuse before time runs out.
Plant/Defuse is a 5v5, round-based tactical mode built around one life per round.
Attackers carry the bomb and choose where to strike; defenders protect two bomb sites and react to the attack.
There's no respawning during a round, so positioning and picking your fights carefully is everything.
Playable on Sunstroke, Scarred City, Blossom Crash, and Eden.

A Top 100 leaderboard is now available for Plant/Defuse. From the Leaderboard tab, you can toggle between Plant/Defuse and Quick Match to view the top-ranked players in either mode, along with your own position on the ladder. The Plant/Defuse leaderboard is based on your win rate across all the battles you have completed in the mode. To rank on the leaderboard, you need to play at least 5 battles. More information on the leaderboard for Quick Match below.

notes.title: New: Top 100 Leaderboard – Quick Match Only

items.text: Quick Match has also gained a Top 100 leaderboard that lets you track how you stack up against the best. Accessible from a new Leaderboard tab in the top menu of the Garage, it shows the current highest-performing players for Season 1 as well as your own ranking.
Rankings and respective scores are calculated based on players' average scores over the last 50 battles, which is the number of battles you’ll need to play to place on the leaderboard.
The new Top 100 Players leaderboard, with a mode toggle between Quick Match and Plant/Defuse.

Feel the need to switch up your strategy mid-match? Now, during the respawn window after your vehicle is destroyed, you can swap to your Agent's other tank for a fresh approach. Your Agent stays for the whole battle, but each time you come back in, you get to pick whichever of their two vehicles suits the moment best. This feature will not be available for Plant/Defuse mode.
During the respawn window, pick whichever of your Agent's two vehicles suits the moment.
Points for Critical Damage at Range 75 → 60
Points for Fully Capping a Capture Point 5 → 10

We've made several adjustments to the Operation Phoenix tutorial mission to smooth out the experience. Mines have been replaced with hedgehog obstacles, still blocking your path to the experimental tank but without the risk of unnecessary destruction. The ambush attack you encounter along the way has also been made less punishing, with one HSTV-L tank removed. Finally, the railgun experimental tank fight has been made more manageable, with its HP reduced by 40% and its damage output also lowered.
Fixed an issue with the Decoy ability for Hound's LEO 1A6A1 where the Doppelbombe module caused it to only Trace one nearby enemy instead of all enemies within range when the decoy was destroyed.
Fixed an issue on Flair's LEO 2FK where activating Feign Death while the camera was positioned inside the vehicle could result in parts of the tank blocking the Sniper mode view.
Fixed an issue with the Decoy ability for Hound's LEO 1A6A1 where the decoy did not deploy a Smoke area on destruction with the Nebeltrick module installed.
Fixed an issue with Kent's Contracted Strike Ultimate where the Hellfire missile did not track moving targets as it should.
Fixed an issue where completing Flair or Reaper's 4th progression level did not grant the expected Skill Points.
Fixed an issue where locked vehicles belonging to Flair incorrectly displayed a "Coming Soon" label, even though the vehicle was already available to unlock.

Fixed an issue in Control mode where being destroyed right as a base capture completed and the match transitioned to the next round could prevent a player’s vehicle from respawning, locking them out of the following round.
Fixed an issue where a tank's destruction effect and sound would incorrectly play a second time once the respawn timer ended.
Fixed an issue where the OBJ. 287's rear hull armor value was set too low and incorrectly displayed as 0 in the in-game visualizer.
Fixed an issue where turret traverse speed and hull rotation speed were slower on gamepad compared to keyboard and mouse.
Fixed an issue on consoles where speech indicators for Squad members were not displayed for players between vehicle destruction and the Deployment screen.

Fixed an issue where binding Tactical Map, Shoot, or Alternative Firing to their default buttons (Touchpad, R2, and L2 respectively) incorrectly flagged them as "modified," even though they matched the default settings.
Fixed an issue on PS5 where activating or deactivating the LEO 2KST's Active Camo ability could sometimes cause the game to crash.

topNew: Jump in every weekend this August

releases.displayName: Dev Talk #2: The New Patch and What Comes Next

items.text: A lot has happened since the last Dev Talk. Artyom picks the thread back up: what shipped over the past few weeks, what the next patch brings, and what the team is building toward.
Season 1 went live a few weeks ago with a new Agent, two tanks, a new Battle Pass, and a new post-match flow. It was a smoother release than our first, with fewer bugs and fewer crashes.
Test drive any tank before you commit to it, a Credits boost from new starter missions, Ultimate cinematics off by default, and cleaner replay storage. The detail is in the 1.1.1 patch notes.
What is in the new patch

Plant/Defuse, a fast round-based mode starting with weekend runs so we can gather your feedback and get it right. In-battle vehicle rotation returns, letting you switch to your Agent's other tank each time you respawn. Top 100 leaderboards arrive in a first iteration with basic ranking criteria. Alongside those: fixes to the tutorial mission, an improved gamepad experience, and stability work. The 1.1.2 patch notes go through the whole release line by line.

A new Agent and three new tanks join the roster, including a second machine for Ember, plus a new map to explore. Season 2 also marks the start of our seasonal framework: a new season roughly every three months, each with its own theme, content, and story. We will share more very soon.

Social features to play together and competitive features to display your mastery are among the things you ask for most. We are currently looking into both. There is no timeline we can commit to right now, and we will share more down the line.
We want your feedback on the new game mode. The conversation is happening on Discord.
Update 1.1.1 goes live on July 16, 2026, at 7:00 AM UTC.
Update 1.1.1 brings a set of quality-of-life upgrades you asked for, alongside a broad wave of fixes across progression, console controls, core gameplay, and maps. Here's what's changed.

You asked, we listened. To help you feel confident in every purchase, you can now hop into the Firing Range with any vehicle straight from the Agent Selection screen and get a real feel for its handling before you buy. Look for the "\[Firing Range] (HOLD)" prompt at the bottom of the screen. Hold \ on PC, \ on PlayStation, or \ on Xbox to launch. Once you're done, you'll be returned to the screen you started from: the Agent Selection screen if you launched from there, or the Lobby if you launched via the Play button.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746833/e9f5f1a8d0c7ff306c57a6bfdfe2c013dae8ac14.png"]Hold the Firing Range prompt on the Agent Selection screen to test-drive any tank before you buy.

Many of you told us you wanted more control over your vehicle during Ultimate activations, so you can stay focused on the battlefield. That's why we've added a new gameplay setting that lets you disable Ultimate cinematics entirely. When turned off, Ultimates no longer take over the camera, so you stay aware of your vehicle and the battlefield throughout activation. For balancing reasons, all vehicles that previously had a cinematic (excluding Hound's) now have a very short "Preparing Ultimate" charge. During this charge time, you are still able to move, shoot, and use abilities.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746833/b1a24446677e2f5ceb8b0d1aaa2051544c59ca7f.png"]The new setting to disable Ultimate cinematics.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746833/82bb137742b7cad747280a91fc3bb5891c08a519.gif"]With cinematics off, the camera stays on your vehicle instead of cutting away during the Ultimate.

We want your first steps onto the battlefield to feel exciting, not overwhelming. That's why we've added a new mission chain to help new players get rolling, and it's available to veteran accounts too, if you'd like to complete it.
Complete a battle in any of your three starting vehicles to kick off the chain.
Finishing that mission unlocks the next one for your remaining starting vehicles, one battle each.
Complete all three missions to earn bonus currency, giving you a head start toward your first non-starter vehicle.
These missions never expire, so there's no rush. Complete them whenever you're ready.

Some abilities and weapons have natural variance built into their damage or penetration values, which we call Deviation. For example, an ability with a Deviation of 10 might land 10 points above or below its listed value on any given hit, keeping combat dynamic rather than identical every time.
Data Surge increases the ability damage of Fuzzer's vehicles.

Killer Algorithm gives Fuzzer's vehicles a bonus to weapon damage for 5 s after dealing a critical hit, and now applies only to the specific bonus received. Its stack cap is now 1, and it no longer affects abilities.
Memory Expansion gives Fuzzer's vehicles a cooldown reduction on all abilities, and it now also modifies the TOW ATGM restock rate.
Tooltips for Data Surge and Killer Algorithm have been updated.
TOW ATGM alpha damage min. value

Smart Mines has been reworked from a cooldown to a charge-based ability with 2 charges. Each charge is consumed separately, and using one costs Energy. Getting Jammed while in Smart Mines placement mode now cancels the ability.

The placement telegraph has been adjusted to match the new cone. Explosion damage when a mine is destroyed has been removed, and the removal explosion visual effect has changed. The Smart Mines tooltip has been updated.

On Fuzzer's Marder 1A3, the RIMCAP 3 and PARM B modules did not correctly affect Smart Mines damage, and the damage shown on the Stats screen and progression module cards was inaccurate. This is now fixed.
HEAT ATGM ammo penetration min. value

Fixed a localization issue on Flair’s Leo 2KST Agent Features screen where the name and description of the Active Camo ability were not translated. Text now displays correctly across supported languages.
Fixed a Russian localization issue where positive attribute bonuses in Agent Skill descriptions were missing the "+" symbol. Buff values are now displayed with the correct formatting.
Fixed an issue where the buff value in the Overload Skill description (Ember) and Conservative Skill description (Hound) was not highlighted in yellow, specifically in the Ukrainian localization.

Fixed an issue where certain modules for Reaper’s M60A2 (BTA-2345-S, EMS-1523, AGD-1647) and the "Airburst Energy Cost" / "Autocannons Energy Cost" parameters displayed untranslated technical text in several localizations instead of proper translated labels.
Fixed an issue where Hound's Exposed Agent Skill (Trait, Tier 2) description remained untranslated in all localizations other than English.
You can now check out full details for any Agent or vehicle on the Agent Selection screen, whether they’re locked or unlocked, so you can plan ahead before you unlock them.
Fixed an issue where earned medals were sometimes not displayed on the Battle Results screen, even though they appeared correctly on the Post-Battle screen.
Fixed an issue where the "Claim" button could remain locked after claiming a reward tier if the mouse wasn't moved away from the button, preventing players from claiming subsequent tiers.
Fixed an issue where the "new content" indicator on an Agent Skill remained visible even after it was already viewed.
Fixed an issue where Battle Pass description text could blend into the background and become hard to read at low resolutions.

Added an in-battle controls reference screen, allowing you to quickly check current key bindings and available actions during a match. This is available for both keyboard & mouse and gamepad across all supported platforms.
Fixed an issue where controller movement bindings, Move Forward, Move Backward, Turn Left, and Turn Right, could not be individually remapped, unlike keyboard and mouse controls.

Fixed an issue on PS5 where, in rare cases, accepting a Squad invite and pressing "Play" at nearly the same time could cause a player to be queued for matchmaking twice, potentially placing them in the same match twice or in two separate matches simultaneously.

Fixed an issue where the Shift key would stop responding after switching between control presets while using a keyboard and mouse on PS5. Previously, activating "Restore Shooter Controls" or "Load Legacy Controls" from the Settings > Controls menu could cause Shift to stop triggering Engine Boost or Sniper mode as expected. Shift now works correctly immediately after switching control schemes.
Fixed a crash that could occur when quickly opening and closing the Modify Agent screen in rapid succession. The UI now handles fast navigation between these screens without crashing.

Fixed an issue where braking to a stop and then pressing a turn key could cause the tank to steer in the opposite direction than expected, due to reverse-steering logic triggering before the tank had actually shifted into reverse.
Fixed an issue where moving the Left or Right Stick while binding an action would also navigate the Controls menu at the same time.
Fixed an issue on PS5 and Xbox where voice chat did not connect to the microphone when communicating with Squad members.

Fixed an issue where, on PS5 and Xbox using a real keyboard and mouse, a virtual keyboard would unexpectedly appear when using search fields (Invite to Squad, Custom Game Setup), making it difficult to select players or exit the field.

New: When remapping controls, if you assign an input that's already bound to another action, you'll now see a confirmation prompt letting you know about the conflict before it's applied, giving you the choice to bind it anyway or pick a different input instead.

New: You can now choose between Hold or Toggle input methods for Engine Boost and Toggle Turret Lock in the Controls settings, letting you customize how these actions are activated to fit your preferred playstyle.
Fixed an issue where Flair's Hidden Trap Skill widget was missing its descriptive text when activated in battle.
Fixed an issue where the team scores shown on the scoreboard (opened via Tab) didn't match the team scores displayed on the main battle HUD.
Fixed an issue where Flair's Leo 2KST Active Camo ability would be interrupted by pressing the fire button while reloading, even though no shot was actually fired.
Fixed an issue where the shadow of Flair's Leo 2KST remained visible to other players while the Active Camo ability was active.
Fixed an issue where Twister's M551A1 Canister Volley ability incorrectly displayed the "Switching" widget after firing, when it should only appear while switching to the ability.
Fixed an issue on Aircraft Carrier where Reaper's Napalm in the Morning ability could pass through building roofs. Napalm now correctly collides with rooftops and ignites on the roof surface.
Fixed multiple issues affecting Flair's Echo Proxy after a client crash or disconnection, including being unable to switch to the proxy and losing HUD elements.
Fixed an issue where the Toughness HATT-5 module on the M1E1 did not correctly convert dealt damage into HP recovery.
Fixed an issue where Flair's Leo 2KST would lose its Active Camo masking effect if it had already taken damage that deactivated her Signature Masking Trait.
Fixed an issue with a Marder 1A3 mission where the target value for destroying 5 enemies with the Suppression Strike ability was instead set at a much higher number.

Fixed an issue where Flair's main tank taking damage would interrupt Recovery Kit or Rebuild Kit healing for her Echo Proxy. The healing would then appear active but not actually function until the affected vehicle took damage (or activated Feign Death if using the Leo 2FK). Recovery Kit and Rebuild Kit now heal the tank and its proxy independently, with damage to one no longer affecting the other.
Fixed an issue with Flair's Leo 2FK and Leo 2KST where activating Sniper mode after switching from the Echo Proxy back to the main tank could result in parts of the tank obscuring aiming.

Fixed an issue where quickly canceling the Leo 1A6A1's Decoy ability while opening the Tactical Map could cause the reticle HUD to disappear and controls, including firing, Sniper mode, camera zoom, and the menu, to become unresponsive.
Fixed an issue where, unlike other vehicles, Flair's Echo Proxy tank model remained partially visible from inside the vehicle when the camera clipped into it (e.g. aiming very high).
Fixed an FPS drop that could occur when viewing Dirty Substance fire effects through the scope on Kent's ALVT. Performance now remains stable when zooming near active fire effects.
Fixed an issue where Raketa's legs would clip under the terrain in the right-side post-battle camera position.
Fixed an issue on Sunstroke (Control mode) where driving outside the gameplay area did not trigger the 10-second "Turn Back" timer.
Fixed an issue on Aircraft Carrier where a gap in the terrain allowed vehicles to slightly fall through the ground instead of driving over it normally.
Fixed an issue where Flair’s Echo Proxy could be placed in unintended locations, such as tight spaces within map structures, granting an unfair positional advantage.
Fixed an issue where more than the intended 10 replay files could accumulate locally instead of automatically deleting the oldest replay when a new one was saved.

New: The following Season 0 3D skins are now purchasable directly from the Customization menu: "Silent Approach" for Hound and his Leo 1A6A1, "Off the Record" for Kent and his XM190, and "Old Reliable" for Chopper and his M1E1.
Fixed an issue where Flair's missions were only visible once her vehicles were unlocked.

Fixed an issue where, after navigating to the Store from the Customization screen via a skin bundle banner and switching vehicles, switching back to the original vehicle did not correctly restore its selected skin.

This update is all about smoothing out the everyday experience, from trying tanks before you buy to keeping control of your camera in a fight. We're still reading your feedback and we've got more on the way in upcoming updates. Thanks for playing, and for helping us make HEAT better.

We’re preparing the first pack of fixes, which will be delivered in Patch 1.01 tomorrow. This is a small patch that will address a number of bugs and will provide technical fixes, as well as changes to the current Role Points system. Deployment will start at 7:00 UTC and will take around two hours. During the maintenance period, the servers will be unavailable. Here’s the full list of changes.

Role Points are your in-game score and reflect your contribution during a match and can be viewed on your in-game scoreboard. Generally, the higher your Role Point score, the greater your Credit and XP earnings. In general, there is a direct correlation between match performance, Role Points earned, and post-battle rewards. As a result of these adjustements, the previous economy & post battle earnings will be reverted. We're making some adjustments to how Role Points are earned across different events.

These changes are intended to speed up progression for most vehicles and make progression rates more consistent across the roster as well as to bring HSTV-L progression closer to the intended pace, as it's currently progressing faster than expected and, lastly, to reduce differences in XP earnings between match modes, helping ensure a more consistent progression experience regardless of which mode you play.

notes.title: This is how Role Points will be adjusted

items.text: Fixed: issue where Daily Vehicle Missions would occasionally fail to refresh after completing all available missions and waiting for the next daily reset. You should now receive a new mission each day as intended.
Fixed: bug where Battle Pass would fail to display when opened for the first time after logging in.
Resolved: login issue that could prevent from entering the game after reconnecting multiple times. This resulted in an endless loading state.
Fixed: UI issue in the Conquest game mode that could cause objective status notifications to overlap with Bombing Event alerts.
Fixed: bug with Hound's Hunting Time ability. The ability now correctly marks nearby enemies after successful execution.

Fixed: issue with charge based ability (e.g. Hound Leopard1A6A1's Decoy, Ember's XM1V's Minefield, Chopper's FV4030 X's Bastion) where the UI in the HUD did not display the correct counters. These are now displayed correctly.
Fixed: tech issue for PS5, improving game stability when resuming play after periods of inactivity.
Updated: World of Tanks: Modern Armour inspired layout for a more intuitive control experience.
We'll keep monitoring your reports and overall game health. Once again thank you for your feedback and let us know of any questions or comments in the discussion threads.

Thank you for all of your feedback regarding the in-game economy and post-battle earnings. We've carefully reviewed your comments, data, and suggestions, and have made adjustments based on that feedback.
As part of this update, we've increased post-battle Credit earnings for all vehicles, with the exception of the HSTV-L, to better align rewards with our intended progression and earning rates.

We appreciate everyone who took the time to share their experiences and help us improve the game. Please keep the feedback coming, we'll continue monitoring the economy and making adjustments where needed.
